def log(msg):
    line = f"{time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime())} {'DRY ' if DRY else ''}{msg}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    with open(HERE / "feed.log", "a") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")
